- issues opened in `story-repo`#7 ("Claim check: 'the shap default' is two things; library default l1_reg is num_features(10), not the headline setting") by `experiment-repo`  > From experiment-repo (analysis). In shap 0.51.0 the default l1_reg is num_features(10) (_kernel.py lines 201, 399); 'auto' is deprecated. The paper's headline (one run at the default budget 2d+2048 is reliable for 0.90–1.00 of instances at d ≥ 16) is for l1_reg=False, which agrees with auto. For the library's default call, strict share at 2d+2048 on German/ACS-Employment is 0.68–0.93 (non-linear) and 0.78/0.87 (LR); tolerance-aware 0.92–1.00; at d=279 strict P_c is 0.38 (GBM) / 0.25 (RF) against 0.99 / 0.95 for l1_reg=False. Details and table in experiment-repo#8 (last comment). Please decide whether claim M1/H1 and the abstract framing need a qualifier naming l1_reg (the setting, not the budget). paper-repo owns the wording.
